_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the PhantomBot egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: PhantomBot
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: PhantomBot is an open source Twitch chat bot with moderation, games, alerts and a Discord bot. Downloads the official release; set it up from its web page on the server's port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PhantomBot: downloads PhantomBot (the build without a bundled Java) from
# its GitHub releases. config (botlogin.txt and the database), addons,
# logs and custom scripts are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

version="${RELEASE_VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag PhantomBot/PhantomBot "$version") || exit 1
version="${tag#v}"
asset="PhantomBot-${version}-bot_only.zip"

if [ -f PhantomBot.jar ] && [ "$(cat .phantombot-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "PhantomBot $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading PhantomBot $version."
    gh-release download PhantomBot/PhantomBot "$tag" "$asset" $work/pb.zip
    mkdir -p $work/pb
    unzip -q $work/pb.zip -d $work/pb
    src=$(find $work/pb -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -n 1)
    # The program and its libraries are replaced whole; config and addons
    # only get files they don't have yet.
    # Custom scripts are set aside while scripts is replaced.
    for c in scripts/custom scripts/lang/custom; do
        [ -d "$c" ] && mkdir -p "$work/keep/$c" && cp -a "$c"/. "$work/keep/$c"/
    done
    for d in "$src"/*; do
        name=$(basename "$d")
        case "$name" in
            config|addons) mkdir -p "$name"; cp -an "$d"/. "$name"/ ;;
            *) rm -rf "$name.new"; cp -a "$d" "$name.new"; rm -rf "$name"; mv "$name.new" "$name" ;;
        esac
    done
    [ -d $work/keep/scripts ] && cp -a $work/keep/scripts/. scripts/
    echo "$version" > .phantombot-version
fi
[ -f java.opt.custom ] || touch java.opt.custom
echo "Installed PhantomBot $version. Start it, then open the bot's web page on the server's port to finish the setup."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The PhantomBot version to install, such as 3.24.2.1, or latest.
